b: Authorization for the Social Security Administration to Disclose Your Social Security Number Verification

runs: I authorize the Social Security Administration (SSA) to verify and disclose to X Payments LLC through Socure Inc. for the purpose of this transaction whether the name, Social Security Number (SSN) and date of birth I have submitted matches information in SSA records, including the basis for a no-match response. My consent is for a one-time validation within the next 90 days.
